caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden object with a curved, elongated oval shape, rendered in shades of brown and tan to represent wood grain and texture. The object features a prominent central rectangular block attached to its upper surface, from which a vertical wooden peg rises. A circular hole is present on the left end of the object, and both ends are squared off, with the left side having a notch just below the hole. There are also smaller notches cut into the lower edge on either side of the central block. The background of the drawing is a plain, light beige color, and the surface of the wooden object is depicted with fine lines to indicate the grain and knots in the wood.
title: Marking Gauge for Barrels
